title: BBD gluing of unbounded derived objects over an arbitrary open cover with vanishing negative Ext

standard_prerequisites.name: Standard derived sheaf operations
standard_prerequisites.statement: K-injective resolutions, extension by zero for open embeddings, compatibility of derived pushforward with restriction, and exactness of filtered colimits on stalks.

standard_prerequisites.name: Derived Hom and Mayer-Vietoris
standard_prerequisites.statement: Derived internal Hom computes local Ext and H^0 computes derived-category Hom; two-open Mayer-Vietoris gives the exact Hom sequence.

standard_prerequisites.name: Elementary topology of a subcollection of opens
standard_prerequisites.statement: A covering family stable under intersections up to unions is the inverse image of a basis under a continuous map; take the topology generated by this family on the underlying set.

core_obligations: Construct the two-open gluing object as the fiber of the derived restriction-difference map, and derive uniqueness/sheaf behavior of morphisms from negative Ext vanishing.
Strictify compatible derived transition maps on a well-ordered increasing open cover using K-injective representatives and exact filtered colimits at limit stages.
Run transfinite induction through successor and limit opens, recovering all prescribed local identifications by uniqueness and verifying the resulting global descent datum.
